title: Style-Locked Asset Generation Orchestrator
objective: Provide provider-neutral, deterministic style-locked asset-generation job preparation over governed style/reference projections while preserving owning content/ARI authority, PCA recipe/provider authority, cost and routing controls, and keeping generated assets as candidates until owning workflows accept them.

scope.purpose: Prepare provider-neutral style-locked asset-generation jobs without allowing any generation engine or provider to become canonical source authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative governed style/reference inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable provider-neutral generation jobs with stable cache/provenance and bounded routing/budget/review behavior while generated outputs remain candidate assets until owning workflows accept them and invalid owner/reference/provider/budget states fail closed.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01..08 remain completed foundations and were composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.
PCA-01 retains recipe/provider/clean-room/provenance preparation authority; PCA-02 retains reusable graph/resource-budget authority.
ARI-02/ARI-03/ARI-11 retain resource identity, derivative lineage and rights/use authority; PCA-09 required transform rights and emitted candidate registration references only.
Owning content/art domains retain canonical style/reference truth and generated-asset acceptance authority; PCA-09 consumed validated owner projections and created no parallel style registry.

Generation engines/providers remain replaceable executors only; PCA-09 performed no credential access, network/provider execution, paid-service operation, procurement, public upload, publication, release, ARI registration or canonical mutation.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree PCA-09 publication. PCA-09 satisfies MCCS's PCA-09 prerequisite, but MCCS remains blocked by PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER; MCS and MSAS likewise remain blocked by PCA-15/barrier requirements. PCA-10's direct gates PCA-02, CNI-05 and CNI-08 are already satisfied, so PCA-10 is the lawful next selected item.
PCA-10 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.

red.failure_signature: missing PCA-09 style-locked generation contract module

next_action: PCA-09 is closed. PCA-10 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
